title: Update module 1 - an intro to the lab

value: Athena deep agent repo: https://github.com/rhpds/athena-aiops-deep-agent.git — the actual codebase the workshop is about. sre_ssh was replaced with sre_package_management (Satellite content views, CRB requirements).

SVG diagrams: always remove max-width caps from root SVG element so they fill the Showroom content panel. Use width=100% in AsciiDoc. Use link=self for popout, never say 'click to enlarge' in alt text.

Mermaid CLI rendering: use 'npx @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli -i input.mmd -o output.svg' (no 'mmdc' subcommand on v11+). For sequence diagrams, keep participants to 5 or fewer for readability in split-panel layouts.

Testing showroom changes: push to branch, then kill the showroom pod in the user's namespace (e.g. oc delete pod -n user-z4ckh-showroom). Pod respawns with new content from the branch. Cluster: cluster-d9lfp.dynamic.redhatworkshops.io.
Tony's reference deep-agents showroom: https://tonykay.github.io/showroom-deep-agents/ — has context bloat failure modes, subagent fundamentals, and other Deep Agents content that can be referenced.

AsciiDoc conventions: capitalize section headings (Title Case). role=execute on source blocks for copy button. link=self for image popout. No trailing period after credentials. No blank line after ==== admonition delimiter. Pre-render Mermaid as SVGs.

Data sovereignty is a key theme: Red Hat blog refs — sovereignty-emerges-defining-cloud-challenge-emea-enterprises (63% EMEA stat), open-source-transparency-defines-future-sovereign-ai-europe. Module 1 has dedicated Data Sovereignty section.
Terminology: standardize on 'AIOps' not 'DevOps' for the product/team. Use 'Open Source' spelled out, never 'OSS'. Use 'First Generation' / 'Second Generation' for agent types, not 'Agent 1.0/2.0'.
Tony Kay is AI Lead, Consulting Technical Marketing Manager at Red Hat. Building Summit 2026 workshop LB 2645 (Agentic AIOps). Works on Showroom labs using Antora/AsciiDoc.

Workshop structure: index.adoc (merged welcome+overview), 5 core modules, conclusion, 2 bonus modules (Deep Agents Deep Dive, Tracing). Unused pages archived to content/modules/ROOT/pages-archive/ (outside Antora pages/ to avoid xref errors).
